# RightClick:AI

> AI Operating Systems for service businesses in Singapore. Built and run by Bolun (Ben) Liu. The Foundation Build delivers four functions — operational dashboard, workflow automation, AI assistant, and notification centre — scoped per client after a paid audit and built on your real data. You own the code outright. No PSG / EDG grant paperwork.

## What RightClick:AI is

RightClick:AI builds custom AI Operating Systems for service businesses in Singapore with 5 to 35 staff. Built and run by Bolun (Ben) Liu, working solo with a tight specialist network — no subcontractors, no handoffs. Clients work directly with the same person from discovery call to deployment. Every system is scoped in writing before any build starts, ships a working MVP on real data, and is built around your business. The client owns the source code, infrastructure, deployment, SOPs, and knowledge wiki outright on delivery. No SaaS lock-in. No platform dependency. Any developer can pick up and extend the system.

## The two engagement paths

**Foundation Build — scoped per client after the audit.**
For businesses building from scratch or with light existing tooling. Four functions: operational dashboard with role-based access, one workflow automation chosen during scoping, AI assistant grounded on live business data, and notification centre. Scoped per client after the audit and built on real data. The 30-minute discovery call is free; the full scope comes before any build. I build until it's live and doing the job. Stop anytime — all code delivered is the client's regardless.

**Custom Build — RFQ.**
For clients with an existing system to rebuild (Notion CRM, custom app, spreadsheets that quietly became operations), scope larger than the four Foundation functions, or a system that needs to live inside an existing product. Same process. Same commitments. I build until it's live and doing the job. Scoped per project after the audit. No fixed Custom price is published because no build of this shape can be honestly quoted without an audit.

**Function Cycles — scoped per cycle.**
After Foundation, the system extends one capability per cycle, scoped after the audit. Pay-as-you-go. No annual contract. Stop and restart anytime.

**Maintain Mode — annual subscription, opt-in.**
Hosting, updates, AI model refresh, async support. Optional. Far cheaper than the SaaS stack the system replaces.

## Stage philosophy

**Stage 1 — Operational Visibility.** Centralise the business's data into a single environment so the founder understands what is happening across the entire business without asking anyone, opening multiple systems, or waiting on a status update. The Foundation Build delivers Stage 1 end-to-end.

**Stage 2 — Growth Automation.** Automate operational workflows so operations become faster and less dependent on manual effort. The business scales without proportional headcount growth. Function Cycles deliver Stage 2 capability by capability.

## Why no grants

RightClick:AI does not work with PSG or EDG grants. Grant routes add 3 to 6 months of approval time before any code is written and freeze scope during the wait — the system delivered is the one specced months earlier with less information. Clients pay out of cashflow because they want the system live fast, not next quarter. If grant cost-recovery is the top priority, RightClick:AI is not the right fit. If speed and clarity are, this is built for them.

## The Data Process Thinking Method

Before any automation, every workflow is mapped: input → output at every stage, expenditure vs ROI, invisible micro-processes surfaced, and the data audit (does the data exist, can it support the decision) completed. Most AI automation failures happen before the first tool is chosen. The bottleneck is clarity of process, not capability of technology. One overlooked logical detail can break an entire system.
